> Explain in three sentences what a race condition is. Do not use any tools.

▸ Thought for 1s, 352 tokens
  Defining the core concept
  A race condition occurs when a system's behavior depends on the relative timing or sequence of concurrent
  operations executing across multiple threads or processes. It typically happens when two or more operations access
  shared resources simultaneously without adequate synchronization and at least one operation modifies the resource
  state. As a result, non-deterministic execution order can lead to data corruption, inconsistent application states,
  or unpredictable runtime bugs.
